title: A week of every bus and train in Phoenix
description:
A week of every bus and train in Phoenix, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Phoenix city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Local, Express and Rail, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 314 vehicles, Monday at 4:45 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12).
